development_selection_rule: first four ascending NTHC participant IDs with resting fMRI and all 11 TMS-site runs in the official participant-information table

first_level_glm.motion_regressors: six rigid-body parameters plus first derivatives
first_level_glm.motion_censoring: one-hot regressors for fMRIPrep motion outliers and framewise displacement > 0.5 mm

spatial_response_instrument.local_roi: released binary stimulation sphere for each site
spatial_response_instrument.local_susceptibility: absolute value of mean signed beta within stimulation sphere
spatial_response_instrument.remote_propagation: equal-weighted mean absolute parcel beta outside buffered local field
spatial_response_instrument.signed_remote_components: equal-weighted positive beta and negative-beta magnitude retained separately
spatial_response_instrument.response_extent: fraction of remote parcels with absolute parcel-mean z >= 3.1
spatial_response_instrument.conditional_propagation: estimated across participant-site observations by including local response as a covariate

resting_functional_embedding.connectivity: Pearson correlation among cleaned Schaefer-100 parcel time series with diagonal set to zero
resting_functional_embedding.target_parcel: unique Schaefer parcel with maximum voxel overlap with released stimulation sphere
resting_functional_embedding.negative_strength: sum of absolute negative off-diagonal correlations
resting_functional_embedding.mixed_sign_strength: square root of positive strength times negative strength
resting_functional_embedding.global_signal_regression: mandatory parallel sensitivity analysis using the cleaned whole-brain global signal
resting_functional_embedding.confirmatory_predictors: positive strength, negative strength, and their explicit interaction

primary_predictions: negative and mixed-sign resting functional embedding predict absolute remote TMS-evoked propagation conditional on local response
lower total absolute embedding predicts greater local susceptibility
signed embedding improves participant-held-out prediction over unsigned total strength
primary_outcomes: remote evoked beta conditional on local response
mandatory_sensitivities: with and without global signal regression
positive and negative evoked betas separately
prohibited_claims: negative resting correlation is a direct inhibitory anatomical connection
